page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8a.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance type built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system utilizes the x86_64 architecture and is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a consistent allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It also lacks integrated GPU hardware, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or GPU-bound machine learning tasks. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density per vCPU makes this instance type suitable for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the overhead of paying for excess compute cores. Appropriate workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data analytics pipelines, and memory-intensive caching layers.
